population.condition: type 2 diabetes mellitus in spontaneous postmenopausal women
key_inclusion_criteria: spontaneous postmenopausal female patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus
hemoglobin A1c of 7% to 10% despite using only metformin
naive to insulin and incretin-based treatments

arms.name: exenatide group
arms.dose: 5 mcg 2 × 1/day, revised after 1 month to 10 mcg 2 × 1/day

arms.name: glargine group
arms.dose: 0.2 IU/kg at 10.00 PM, with titration according to the average 3-day morning fasting blood glucose value
